product_overview: FadeInbox is a privacy-focused disposable email platform that lets users generate temporary inboxes, receive and inspect messages in real time, and quickly extract OTPs or verification links. It also supports safe attachment previews, multi-account management, optional cloud vault sync, and interface customization.
core_goals: Generate temporary email addresses for private, short-term communication
Monitor and read incoming messages in a live inbox
Extract OTP codes and verification links from incoming email
Preview attachments safely in-browser without downloading
Manage multiple active temporary accounts and extend their lifespan
Save messages and past addresses to a permanent vault when signed in
Customize the interface language and visual theme

features.name: Instant Temporary Email Generator
features.description: Create disposable email addresses with random or custom usernames, choose a domain, and set how long the address stays active.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Generate a new email address -> View the created temporary address and its expiration timer
Navigate to / -> Enter a custom username -> Select a domain -> Select a lifespan duration -> Create the email address -> View the new custom address
Navigate to / -> Generate a new email address -> Copy the email address for use elsewhere

features.name: Real-Time Live Inbox and Message Reader
features.description: Watch for new incoming messages, open them in a reader pane, switch between formatted and plain-text views, and manage individual messages.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> View the incoming message list as new emails arrive -> Select a message -> Read the full message in the reader pane
Navigate to / -> Select a message -> Switch between rich HTML view and raw text view -> Inspect the message in the preferred format
Navigate to / -> Select a message -> Save the message to the vault
Navigate to / -> Select a message -> Delete the message

features.name: Smart OTP and Verification Link Extractor
features.description: Detect verification codes and confirmation links inside incoming emails and let users copy or open them quickly.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Open a message containing an OTP code -> Copy the detected OTP code
Navigate to / -> Open a message containing a verification link -> Open the verification link directly
Navigate to / -> View a message card that contains an OTP code -> Copy the code from the message list

features.name: Audio and Tab Flash Alerts
features.description: Notify the user with sound and a flashing browser tab title when new mail arrives, with a toggle to mute or enable sounds.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Receive a new incoming email -> Hear the alert chime and notice the tab title flash
Navigate to / -> Toggle sound notifications off -> Receive a new incoming email -> Observe that sound alerts are muted
Navigate to / -> Toggle sound notifications on -> Receive a new incoming email -> Hear the alert chime

features.name: Safe In-Browser Attachment Sandbox Preview
features.description: Inspect supported attachments inside a secure preview modal, then close, dismiss, or download files if desired.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Open a message with an attachment -> Open the safe preview -> Inspect the file in the sandbox modal -> Close the preview
Navigate to / -> Open a message with an attachment -> Open the safe preview -> Download the file
Navigate to / -> Open a message with an attachment -> Open the safe preview -> Press Escape to dismiss the preview

features.name: Multi-Account Management and Extension Timer
features.description: Switch between active temporary accounts, extend an account’s lifetime, or delete an active account.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> View multiple active email account cards -> Switch to another active account -> Continue using that inbox
Navigate to / -> View an active account -> Extend its lifespan by 10 minutes -> See the updated expiration timer
Navigate to / -> View an active account -> Delete the active account

features.name: Google Authentication and Permanent Cloud Vault
features.description: Sign in with Google to access a permanent vault of saved messages and past addresses across devices, or continue using the app as a guest.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Sign in with Google -> View the synced vault and history
Navigate to / -> Sign in with Google -> Open the saved vault and history view -> Review past addresses and saved messages
Navigate to / -> Sign in with Google -> Sign out

features.name: Internationalization and Theme Customization
features.description: Switch the interface language across supported locales and toggle between dark and light appearance modes.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Open the language selector -> Choose a language -> See the interface update in the selected language
Navigate to / -> Toggle the theme setting -> See the interface switch between dark and light mode

routes.description: Main disposable email dashboard, generator, live inbox, history vault, and features guide

features.name: Instant Temporary Email Generator
features.description: Generate random or custom disposable email addresses with auto-selected or user-chosen domains and expiration timers
user_interactions: Click Generate New Email button
Select custom domain from dropdown
Input custom username
Select lifespan duration
Click Create Email button
Click Copy Email Address button

features.name: Real-Time Live Inbox and Message Reader
features.description: Auto-polling inbox to receive, read formatted HTML or raw text emails, and view attachments in real time
user_interactions: View incoming email message list
Click message to open in reading pane
Toggle between Rich HTML and Raw Text view
Click Delete Message button
Click Save Message to Vault button

features.name: Smart OTP and Verification Link Extractor
features.description: Automatically parses emails to detect 4-8 digit OTP codes and direct verification URLs
user_interactions: Click 1-click Copy OTP button on message card
Click Copy Code button on Smart Actions banner
Click Open Verification Link to open confirmation URL directly

features.name: Audio and Tab Flash Alerts
features.description: Plays a synthesized Web Audio API chime and flashes the browser tab title upon receiving incoming emails
user_interactions: Click Sound Notification toggle button in Inbox header to mute or unmute

features.name: Safe In-Browser Attachment Sandbox Preview
features.description: Preview attached images, PDFs, and documents directly in a secure modal without downloading
user_interactions: Click Safe Preview button next to attachment
Inspect image or PDF in sandbox modal
Click Close or press Escape to dismiss preview
Click Download button if desired

features.name: Multi-Account Management and Extension Timer
features.description: Switch between multiple active temporary email addresses or extend lifespan by 10 minutes
user_interactions: Click on another active email account card
Click +10 minutes button to extend lifespan
Click Trash icon to delete active account

features.name: Google Authentication and Permanent Cloud Vault
features.description: Sign in with Google to sync and restore saved messages and historical addresses across devices via Firebase
user_interactions: Click Sign In with Google button
Switch to Saved Vault / History tab
View saved messages and past addresses
Click Sign Out

features.name: Internationalization and Theme Customization
features.description: Switch interface language across 10 languages and toggle between dark and light modes
user_interactions: Click Language dropdown in navbar and select language
Click Theme toggle button in navbar to switch between Dark and Light mode
